name: dooles-skills
description: doolecg's Claude Code skills, organised by what I work on: core working rules, dev practices, agents, web and React Native, UI design and games (Unity, Godot, Blender, pixel art, Minecraft/Java), plus project lessons.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Everyday working rules: how to split work across subagents, plain writing, releases, UI changes, interviews before building, and desktop-app and agent-skill basics. Small enough to leave on.

plugins.name: dev-practices
plugins.description: Engineering habits: API design, CI/CD, debugging, ADRs, git workflow, incremental delivery, performance, security, spec-driven development, and GitHub PR, review and auth skills.

plugins.name: agents
plugins.description: Working with agents: delegation, session recall, Hindsight, browser automation, project sync, reverse engineering, model migration and skill-library upkeep.

plugins.name: web-mobile
plugins.description: React Native, TSX, Vite and web work: web-to-React-Native migration, RN web hover bug, frontend UI engineering, browser testing with devtools, cross-platform npm scripts.

plugins.name: ui-design
plugins.description: UI critique and foundations, accessibility, craft, general design review and UX heuristics.

plugins.name: games
plugins.description: Game work: Unity, Core Keeper and Minecraft modding and servers, voxel and pixel art, humanoid FBX rigs, Steam Workshop uploads and royalty-free asset sourcing.

plugins.name: backend
plugins.description: Backend and dev environment: ASP.NET Core with EF Core and PostgreSQL, plus Docker Compose for the dev database.

plugins.name: game-rendering
plugins.description: Game rendering: PixiJS v8 isometric views and isometric pixel-art rules.

plugins.name: project-lessons
plugins.description: Auto-learned one-fact lessons from past sessions (EffectCraft, thumbnail-poc, OpenCode and others).

plugins.name: minecraft-modding
plugins.description: Fabric and NeoForge modding with version-matched APIs, and migrating mods from 1.21.x to 26.1 (from siredvin/minecraft-modding-skills, MIT).

plugins.name: minecraft-multiloader
plugins.description: Architectury mods that share one codebase across NeoForge and Fabric, for Minecraft 26.x or 1.21.x (from jahrome907/minecraft-agent-skills, MIT).

plugins.name: godot-prompter
plugins.description: Godot 4.x skills, agents and hooks for GDScript and C#: architecture, UI, state machines, save/load, testing, profiling (from jame581/GodotPrompter, pinned).
